title: Check your model
tryWithClaude: Ask Claude: what should I fix first to make this model ready for AI?

steps.say: Model quality checks the model against good practice and lists what to fix.
AI readiness scores how well Copilot and your assistant can use this model.
Validation keeps checks you can run again, like a total that must match.
Docs writes up the model for people who did not build it.
What you find in these pages turns into rows in the Plan.
